065/**
066 * Similar to the SsComboBox2, but used when both
067{@code <K>}, the 'bound' value, and {@code <D>}, the
068 * 'display' value, are pulled from a database table.
069 * {@code <K>} is
070 * the 'key' and the display value the 'text' which appears in the combo box.
071 * <p>
072 * This is sometimes used as a Navigator in conjunction with
073 * {@link dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SyncManager}.
074 * Generally the key represents a foreign key to another
075 * table, and the combobox displays the {@code <D>}.
076 * <p>
077 * Optional data for combobox's item, {@code <D2>}, may be specified,
078 * see {@link #setD2ColumnName(String) }. This data may be displayed by the
079 ListItem, see {@link #setD2DisplayEnabled(boolean)} and {@link getListItemFormat()}
080 * <p>
081 * <b>Refer to {@link SsComboBox2} for warnings and caveats.</b>
082 * <p>
083 * <a id="builders-and-generics"></a>
084 * <h2> Builders and generic type parameter capture</h2>
085 * <p>
086 * The ComboBox hierarchy depends on generic parameter type capture. It is used
087 * so that the data read from a database column is converted to the concrete
088 * type specified by the parameter type.
089 * <p>
090 When you have a SsDbComboBox2 with param types that you frequently use, it is
091 convenient to incorporate it into a re-usable class.
092 Here's a simple example where you lock in the types, don't add anything
093 else, MyDbComboBox.Builder just works.
094 {@snippet class=ComboBoxSnippets region=MyDbComboBox}
095 * <p>
096 * This next example, DbComboBox2Extra, does a lot.
097 * <ol>
098 * <li> lock in {@code <K>} and {@code <D>} types
099 * <li> leaves {@code <D2>} for programmer
100 * <li> adds new generic {@code <D3>} for programmer
101 * <li> captures the type of {@code <D3>}
102 * <li> has an AbstractBuilder so the class and Builder are extendable
103 * <li> has a concrete Builder to instantiate the class
104 * </ol>
105 * {@snippet class=ComboBoxSnippets region=ExtendableDbComboBox}
106 * And a usage example
107 * {@snippet class=ComboBoxSnippets region=ExtendableDbComboBoxExample}
108 * With output {@snippet :
109 *     class java.lang.Integer
110 *     class java.lang.String
111 *     class java.lang.Double
112 *     java.util.List<java.lang.Double>
113 *     [7.0, 6.0, 5.0]
114 * }
115 * <p>
116 * <h2>Example with two tables</h2>
117 * <ol>
118 * <li>part_data (part_id, part_name, ...)
119 * <li>shipment_data (shipment_id, part_id, quantity, ...)
120 * </ol>
121 * <p>
122 * Assume you would like to develop a screen for the shipment_data table
123 * including a combobox where the user can choose a part
124 * and a textbox where the user can specify a quantity.
125 * <p>
126 * In the combobox you would want to display the part name rather than part_id
127 * so that it is easier for the user to choose. At the same time you want to
128 * store the id of the part chosen by the user in the shipment table.
129 *
130 * {@snippet class=ComboBoxSnippets region=init}
131 *
132 * @param <K> list item key type
133 * @param <D> list item displayValue type
134 * @param <D2> list item optional extra data field type
135 */
136@SuppressWarnings("serial")
137public class SsDbComboBox2<K, D, D2> extends SsComboBox2<K, D, D2> {
138  /** Logger for component */
139  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();

142   * The column name used to query the values for the bound column keys.
143   * This is generally the PK of the table to which a foreign key is mapped.
144   * NOTE: This is NOT the bound column. It is the source of the keys.
145   */
146  private String primaryKeyColumnName;
147
148  /** The database column that populates the displayValue of combo list item. */
149  private String displayColumnName;
150
151  /** The database column that populates the (optional) data of combo list item. */
152  private String d2ColumnName;
153
154  /** Query used to populate combo box. */
155  private String query;
156
157  /** database connection to populate combobox, optional. */
158  private Connection connection;
159
160  /** Format for any date columns displayed in combo box. */
161  // TODO: Use a SSFormat.
162  private String dateFormat = DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT;
163
164  /** counter for # times that execute() method is called - for testing. */
165  protected int executeCount = 0;
166
167  // TODO: configuration option
168  /** default model type */
169  public static final ModelType DEFAULT_MODEL_DB_COMBO2 = ModelType.GLAZED;
170  private static final String DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT = "MM/dd/yyyy";

172  /**
173   * To build a SsDbComboBox2 with the specified parameters.
174   * @param <K>
175   * @param <D>
176   * @param <D2>
177   * @param <T>
178   */
179  public abstract static class AbstractBuilder<K, D, D2, T extends AbstractBuilder<K, D, D2, T>>
180      extends SsComboBox2.AbstractBuilder<K, D, D2, T> {
181    // all parameters are optional, at least for now
182    private Connection connection;
183    private String query;
184    private String primaryKeyColumnName;
185    private String displayColumnName;
186    private String d2ColumnName;
187    private String dateFormat = DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT;
188
189    /**
190     * AbstractBuilder
191     */
192    public AbstractBuilder() {
193      // SsDbComboBox2 has a different default than SsComboBox2, so set that up.
194      super.modelType(DEFAULT_MODEL_DB_COMBO2);
195    }
196
197    /**
198     * Database connection to use to populate the combobox.
199     * If not set, use shared connection from lookup.
200     * @param val
201     * @return
202     */
203    public T connection(Connection val) {
204      connection = val;
205      return self();
206    }
207    /**
208     * query used to retrieve the values to display in
209     * the combo from the database.
210     * @param val
211     * @return
212     */
213    public T query(String val) {
214      checkString(val, "query");
215      query = val;
216      return self();
217    }
218    /**
219     * column name from the query to populate the {@code Key}
220     * field of the combobox list item.
221     * @param val
222     * @return
223     */
224    public T primaryKeyColumnName(String val) {
225      checkString(val, "primaryKeyColumnName");
226      primaryKeyColumnName = val;
227      return self();
228    }
229    /**
230     * column name from the query to populate the {@code displayValue}
231     * field of the combobox list item.
232     * @param val
233     * @return
234     */
235    public T displayColumnName(String val) {
236      checkString(val, "displayColumnName");
237      displayColumnName = val;
238      return self();
239    }
240    /**
241     * Sets the column name from the query to populate the
242     * {@code <D2>} field of the combobox list item.
243     * If null, the default, or blank then there is no {@code <D2>}
244     * Use this if there's extra data to store in the
245     * combobox list item.
246     * @param val
247     * @return
248     */
249    public T d2ColumnName(String val) {
250      d2ColumnName = val;
251      return self();
252    }
253    /**
254     *
255     * When a displayed column is of type date use this format to display it.
256     * For the pattern refer SimpleDateFormat in java.text package.
257     * @param val
258     * @return
259     */
260    public T dateFormat(String val) {
261      dateFormat = val;
262      return self();
263    }
264  }
265
266  /**
267   * Builder.
268   * @param <K>
269   * @param <D>
270   * @param <D2>
271   */
272  public static class Builder<K, D, D2> extends AbstractBuilder<K, D, D2, Builder<K, D, D2>> {
273    /** self type idiom */
274    @Override
275    protected Builder<K, D, D2> self() {
276      return this;
277    }
278
279    /** Create SsDbComboBox2 */
280    @Override
281    public SsDbComboBox2<K, D, D2> build() {
282      return new SsDbComboBox2<>(this);
283    }
284  }
285
286  private static void checkString(String val, String tag) {
287    if (val == null || val.isBlank())
288      throw new IllegalArgumentException(tag + " must not be null or blank");
289  }
290
291  /**
292   *
293   * @param builder
294   */
295  protected SsDbComboBox2(AbstractBuilder<K, D, D2, ?> builder) {
296    super(builder);
297    // TODO: error checking: query/primaryK, displayC all must be set.
298    if (builder.primaryKeyColumnName == null || builder.primaryKeyColumnName.isBlank()
299        || builder.displayColumnName == null || builder.displayColumnName.isBlank())
300      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
301          "Specify both primaryKeyColumnName and displayColumnName.");
302
303    connection = builder.connection;
304    query = builder.query;
305    primaryKeyColumnName = builder.primaryKeyColumnName;
306    displayColumnName = builder.displayColumnName;
307
308    d2ColumnName = builder.d2ColumnName;
309    keyVisual.setD2Enabled(hasD2());
310
311    dateFormat = builder.dateFormat;
312    getListItemFormat().setFormat(JDBCType.DATE, new SimpleDateFormat(dateFormat));
313  }
314
315  /**
316   * Create a DBComboBox2.
317   */
318  public SsDbComboBox2() {
319    this(new Builder<>());
320  }
321
322  /**
323   * Executes the query specified with setQuery(), populates combobox,
324   * and turns on AutoCompleteSupport.
325   *
326   * @throws Exception may occur querying data or turning on AutoComplete
327   */
328  // See https://stackoverflow.com/questions/15210771/autocomplete-with-glazedlists
329  // for info on modifying lists.
330  // TODO: What's the deal with the Exception?
331  public void execute() throws Exception {
332    logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("%s setting execute count: %d", getColumnForLog(), executeCount++));
333    // (re)query data
334    queryData();
335
336    // since the list was likely blank when the component was bound we need to update
337    // the component again so it can get the text from the list we don't want to do
338    // this if the component is unbound as with an DBComboBox used for navigation.
339    // TODO: rework combo navigation somehow; maybe there's a navigator "thing".
340    if (getRowSet() != null) {
341      //    call using getSsCommon()
342      SsUtils.updateSsComponent_HACK(this);
343    }
344  }
345
346  /**
347   * Populates the list model with the data by fetching it from the database.
348   */
349  private void queryData() {
350    logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("%s Query [%s].", getColumnForLog(), getQuery()));
351
352    // this.data.getReadWriteLock().writeLock().lock();
353    try (Model.Remodel remodel = keyVisual.getRemodel()) {
354      logger.log(TRACE, () -> sf("%s Clearing eventList.", getColumnForLog()));
355      remodel.clear();
356      nullItem = null;
357
358      logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("%s Nulls allowed? %s.", getColumnForLog(), getAllowNull()));
359      adjustForNullItem();
360
361      Statement statement = getConnection().createStatement();
362      try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery(getQuery());) {
363        List<ListItem> newItems = new ArrayList<>();
364        while (rs.next()) {
365          // TODO: multikey
366          // NOTE: direct ResultSet access.
367          // TODO: Can't use RowSetOps.getColumnObject(comp, class)
368          //       because RSC take a RowSet (not a ResultSet),
369          //       maybe more so because there's the undo/redo stuff.
370          K pk = convertToType(rs.getObject(getPrimaryKeyColumnName()), getKeyType());
371          D opt = convertToType(rs.getObject(displayColumnName), getDisplayValueType());
372          logger.log(TRACE, () -> sf("%s pk: %s, opt: %s", pk, getColumnForLog(), opt));
373          D2 opt2 = hasD2() ? convertToType(rs.getObject(d2ColumnName), getD2Type()) : null;
374          logger.log(TRACE, () -> sf("%s opt2: %s", getColumnForLog(), opt2));
375
376          newItems.add(remodel.createKeyDisplayValueItem(pk, opt, opt2));
377        }
378        remodel.addAll(newItems);
379
380        // Configure the listItemFormat with this queries column types
381        establishListItemFormat(
382            getJDBCColumnType(rs, rs.findColumn(displayColumnName)),
383            hasD2() ? getJDBCColumnType(rs, rs.findColumn(d2ColumnName)) : null);
384      }
385    } catch (final SQLException se) {
386      logger.log(Level.ERROR, getColumnForLog() + ": SQL Exception.", se);
387    } catch (final java.lang.NullPointerException npe) {
388      // TODO: why is NullPointerException here?
389      logger.log(Level.ERROR, getColumnForLog() + ": Null Pointer Exception.", npe);
390    }
391  }

394   * Returns the Connection to the database to populate combobox.

399    return connection == null ? SsUtils.dbSupport().getSharedConnection() : connection;
400  }

537  /** {@inheritDoc } */
538  // TODO: Needed? Remove.
539  @Override
540  public boolean updateDisplayValue(K key, D displayValue) {
541    boolean result = false;
542    try {
543      result = super.updateDisplayValue(key, displayValue);
544    } catch (final Exception e) {
545      logger.log(Level.ERROR, getColumnForLog() + ": Exception.", e);
546    }
547    if (!result) {
548      logger.log(WARNING,
549                 () -> sf("%s: Unable to update Keys of [%s] with DisplayValue of '%s'.",
550                          getColumnForLog(), key, displayValue));
551    }
552
553    return result;
554  }
